text:
maria: Async triage — noticed two client reports where stop sequences trigger mid-token and the response sometimes has mismatched tokens vs logprobs. Also max_tokens counting feels off with streaming. Pinging @aj @cheng for API contract check and quick triage.

aj: can you paste a minimal repro? is this happening on hosted only or on Dedicated/Private too?

maria: repro below (hosted + can reproduce on dedicated). request id: rq_2024_11_12_77a9

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwoood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  -d '{
    "model": "open-compat-1",
    "prompt": "Count to ten",
    "max_tokens": 5,
    "stop": ["3"],
    "temperature": 0.0,
    "top_p": 1.0,
    "logprobs": 1
  }'
```

maria: example response (trimmed):

```
{
  "tokens": ["1","2","3"],
  "token_logprobs": [ -0.1, -0.2, null ],
  "finish_reason": "stop"
}
```

maria: note the last token has null logprob even though it was emitted. should that happen?

cheng: that looks like our streaming early-stop path calls the stop matcher before we finalize logits -> we sometimes don't compute the final token's logprob. iirc i had a WIP PR addressing finalization ordering. @taylor can you check runtime behavior?

taylor: i can. quick question: per contract, do we treat `stop` as post-process (i.e., may trim tokens after logits are available) or as a hard generator interrupt (might abort before computing logprobs)? need to be explicit.

sam: contract text says max_tokens is a hard cap on generated tokens, but stop is described as post-filtering that may end generation early. regardless, we should guarantee that for any token present in `tokens`, there is a corresponding `token_logprobs` entry (null only if computationally impossible, e.g., model crashed). trimming shouldn't create length mismatch.

aj: +1. proposal: (1) ensure generation finalizes logits for a token before stop checking when feasible; (2) define that token arrays must be same length; (3) make null logprob an explicit "n/a" only when the runtime truly couldn't compute it. I'll draft contract wording.

maria: thanks. i'll open an RFC with test vectors showing edge cases (streaming + stop mid-token, stop as substring, multiple stops). will include expected arrays and lengths.

taylor: i'll land a small runtime patch to finalize logits before invoking stop matching in the streaming path and run a dedicated canary. will add unit tests for the case in the repro.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary build redwood-runtime@patch/finalize-logits -> dedicated-canary at 2024-11-12T09:00Z :rocket:

cheng: one more edge: temperature/top_p interplay — when `temperature=0` and `top_p<1`, sampler sometimes follows greedy path vs nucleus. need a unit test to ensure deterministic fallback when temp==0 (should be greedy regardless of top_p). i'll add a test.

sam: also check `logprobs` correctness under deterministic fallback; sometimes logprob computation uses the sampling logits path and returns slightly different normalization. ensure we compute logprobs from final logits used for token selection.

maria: action items recap: maria -> RFC + test vectors, taylor -> runtime PR + canary, aj -> contract wording and review, cheng -> unit tests for temp/top_p behavior, sam -> add logprob correctness check in sampling tests. I'll follow up on PR threads. :thumbsup:
